en.headline: Link's first self-built mall opens in Anderson with rooftop play park
en.dek: Ledda Plaza, a three-storey mall of nearly 140,000 square feet in the Anderson development area, began operations on 13 October with a 25,000-square-foot animal-themed rooftop playground.
body: Link Real Estate Investment Trust opened Ledda Plaza, also known as The Anderson, on 13 October in the Anderson development area of Kwun Tong. The three-storey mall covers nearly 140,000 square feet and houses about 30 tenants focused on dining, daily necessities, personal care and retail.

The rooftop features a 25,000-square-foot Pawsitive Park playground divided into animal-themed zones including a hide-and-seek tower, dog-house slide and duck climbing area, along with a six-metre slide. A new Anderson market of about 27,000 square feet also opened inside the complex, and a 24/7 Fitness centre occupies more than 6,000 square feet.

Link said the project is its first fully self-developed retail asset, from land planning through construction and operation, with an investment of about HK$1.6 billion. Occupancy stood at about 83 per cent at opening. The mall is expected to serve residents of several completed Home Ownership Scheme projects and upcoming private housing in the area.

zh.headline: 領展安達臣領達廣場開幕 設2.5萬呎天台樂園
zh.dek: 領展旗下安達臣新發展區全新商場領達廣場於10月13日正式開幕，樓高三層近14萬平方呎，頂層設有約2.5萬平方呎動物主題遊樂空間。
body: 領展房地產投資信託於10月13日在觀塘安達臣道發展區開幕領達廣場（The Anderson）。商場樓高三層、總面積近14萬平方呎，匯聚約30個商戶，涵蓋餐飲、生活服務、個人護理及零售。
頂層天台設有佔地約2.5萬平方呎的「爪爪童樂園」，以動物造型劃分多個主題區域，包括躲貓貓遊樂塔、汪汪滑梯屋及鴨力爬爬樂，並有6米高滑梯。商場內亦設有約2.7萬平方呎的全新安達臣街市，以及超過6000平方呎的24/7 Fitness健身中心。
領展指這是其首個由土地規劃、概念設計、建造至營運一手包辦的零售發展項目，投資額約16億港元。開業時出租率約83%。商場預期服務區內多個已落成居屋及即將落成私人住宅項目的居民。
